blockers.title: Vendored Commercial GSAP License Requirement
blockers.reproducer: Found dist/vendor/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js inside hyperframes@0.9.3 tarball during P0-02 audit. Verified non-distributable without commercial subscription.

blockers.title: HeyGen Cloud Coupling, Telemetry, and Zero-Egress Violation
blockers.reproducer: Static inspection of hyperframes@0.9.3 package files reveals 6 cloud integration modules and telemetry endpoints pointing to HeyGen remote servers.

blockers.title: Unsafe Dynamic Puppeteer Binary Download in Lifecycle Scripts
blockers.reproducer: P0-02 artifact audit flagged puppeteer postinstall script (node install.mjs) and giget remote template fetching.

blockers.title: Audio CFR Timeline Drift During Offline Headless Frame Stepping
blockers.reproducer: Evaluating audio sample alignment shows Web Audio drift under non-realtime headless Chromium execution; baseline renderer achieves 0-drift by computing explicit rational audio samples and using FFmpeg multi-track filtergraph.

blocker_review.transition_decision: Validate chromium-frame-v1 baseline as the primary production engine for P2 POCs (POC-01, POC-02, POC-03). Retain HyperFrames adapter spike as reference and challenger interface.
